38b8fd57: What is Mario's official job in the Nintendo universe?
Mario is a plumber, a job established in Mario Bros. (1983). In Donkey Kong (1981) he was a carpenter.
3a687221: What is the name of the princess Mario rescues most often?
Princess Peach (called Toadstool in early Western releases) is the princess of the Mushroom Kingdom, kidnapped by Bowser in almost every main game.
ed5b449c: What is the name of Mario's brother?
Luigi is Mario's younger brother, usually in green, taller and thinner than Mario. He stars in his own adventures in Luigi's Mansion.
8bc00b58: Which power-up gives Mario a flower that lets him throw fireballs?
The Fire Flower is one of the most iconic power-ups: Mario gets white and red overalls and can throw bouncing fireballs at enemies.
566e9ab7: Bowser, King of the Koopas, is a huge fire-breathing spiked turtle. He has been kidnapping Peach since Super Mario Bros. in 1985.
c77ed8fe: Which 3D Mario game revolutionized platformers in 1996 on N64?
Super Mario 64 (1996) defined the 3D platformer, letting Mario roam freely through 3D worlds. It inspired 3D games for decades.
06c70861: Which power-up makes Mario temporarily invincible?
The Super Star makes Mario invincible for a few seconds: he flashes every color and defeats enemies on contact, to very recognizable music.
a15b8387: What is the name of Rosalina's base in Super Mario Galaxy?
The Comet Observatory is the base of Rosalina and the Lumas. Mario returns there between galaxies.
15c611af: Wario is the greedy, selfish rival, Mario's opposite (the W is an upside-down M). He stars in his own games, Wario Land and WarioWare.
f9f4ddc3: Which Mario game is the best-selling of all time?
Mario Kart 8 Deluxe on Switch has sold more than 60 million copies, making it the best-selling Mario game.
b1591771: In which land is Super Mario World mainly set?
Super Mario World (SNES, 1990) is set in Dinosaur Land, where Mario and Luigi go on vacation and find that Bowser has kidnapped Peach.
35b48d3b: Which dinosaur has been Mario's mount since Super Mario World?
Yoshi is the green dinosaur who has been Mario's companion since Super Mario World. Mario can ride him, and Yoshi can swallow enemies and turn them into eggs.
1fdc4853: Which Mario game on Switch lets you throw your cap at enemies to possess them?
Super Mario Odyssey (Switch, 2017) introduces Cappy: Mario throws him to capture and control enemies, animals and objects, opening up creative exploration.
cd73356f: What is the name of Bowser's son, introduced in Super Mario Sunshine?
Bowser Jr. is Bowser's son. He first appears in Super Mario Sunshine (2002), where he uses a magic paintbrush to cover the island in goop.
5f14e908: Which item gives Mario a cape in Super Mario World?
In Super Mario World, the Cape Feather gives Mario a cape that lets him glide and fly after a running start.
f925a8fa: Which Mario game introduced simultaneous 4-player co-op?
New Super Mario Bros. Wii (2009) introduced 4-player simultaneous play: Mario, Luigi and two Toads can play together in chaotic co-op on the same screen.
4ecad360: What is the name of the final area of Super Mario World?
Valley of Bowser is the final area of Super Mario World, a valley dominated by Bowser's castle. Its music is among the series' most memorable.
bbeb289c: How many stars do you need to face Bowser for the first time in Super Mario 64?
You need 8 stars to open the door to the first Bowser fight. The final battle requires 70, and the game has 120.
20ef7d0a: What is the name of the princess of Sarasaland in the Mario games?
Princess Daisy rules Sarasaland. She first appeared in Super Mario Land (Game Boy, 1989) and is a regular in Mario sports games such as Mario Kart and Mario Tennis.
7a39276c: Which rare power-up turns Mario into metal in Super Mario 64?
Super Mario 64's Metal Cap turns Mario into metal: he becomes invincible and can walk underwater without drowning. It is only available in certain levels.
62b397a7: Which Mario spin-off series involves kart racing?
Mario Kart is the racing series launched in 1992 on SNES. Mario Kart 8 Deluxe on Switch is the best-selling Mario game, with more than 60 million copies.
a8cde659: Which Mario character is a ghost that moves when Mario isn't looking?
Boo is Mario's shy ghost: it creeps toward Mario when his back is turned, but stops and hides its face when he looks at it.
819d6913: What is the first Mario game on Game Boy?
Super Mario Land (1989) is the first Mario on Game Boy, with different enemies and Princess Daisy instead of Peach. It even includes shoot-'em-up levels.
bd3f1ecc: Which costume does the Super Bell give Mario in Super Mario 3D World?
Cat Mario, from the Super Bell, can climb walls, dive and scratch with his claws, which is handy for reaching otherwise inaccessible areas.
9eca383c: What are the haunted levels in the Mario games called?
Ghost Houses are the iconic Boo-filled levels of the Mario series, with fake walls, hidden exits and Boos that only move when Mario turns his back.
abe6d1d2: Which Mario game introduces Yoshi for the first time?
Super Mario World (SNES, 1990) introduces Yoshi. He later got his own games, such as Yoshi's Island and Yoshi's Woolly World.
befaccd0: What is Mario's basic tool in Paper Mario for interacting with the world?
The Hammer is Mario's basic tool in Paper Mario: he uses it to hit switches, uncover secrets and attack enemies that jumping can't reach. Upgraded versions exist.
99ee1990: Who is the main antagonist of Super Mario Odyssey?
Bowser is the antagonist of Super Mario Odyssey: he plans to marry Princess Peach in the Moon Kingdom, forcing Mario and Cappy to chase him across kingdoms all over the world.
2d585562: Which magic object must be recovered to free each world in Super Mario Bros. 3?
In Super Mario Bros. 3, each Koopaling has stolen a king's magic wand and turned him into a creature. Getting the wands back frees the kings.
89fd1802: What is the name of Mario's living hat companion in Super Mario Odyssey?
Cappy is the spirit who inhabits Mario's red cap in Odyssey. He can be thrown to capture enemies and objects, and wants to rescue his sister Tiara, kidnapped by Bowser.
66c8f199: How many main worlds does the original Super Mario Bros. (NES) have?
Super Mario Bros. (NES, 1985) has 8 worlds of 4 levels each, 32 levels in total. World 8 ends at Bowser's castle with the final battle.
c1554e50: Which power-up lets Mario throw iceballs in some games?
In New Super Mario Bros. Wii, the Ice Flower throws balls that freeze enemies. The resulting ice blocks can then be picked up and thrown.
299e4303: What is the name of Bowser's old Magikoopa adviser in Paper Mario?
Kammy Koopa is an old Magikoopa serving Bowser in Paper Mario. She shouldn't be confused with Kamek, another of Bowser's sorcerers.
ca3d50a3: What is the first Mario Kart released on a Nintendo console?
Super Mario Kart (SNES, 1992) launched the franchise: kart racing with Nintendo characters and offensive items (shells, bananas). Its formula is still used today.
74e0b6d8: Which character was created for Mario Tennis on Nintendo 64?
Waluigi first appeared in Mario Tennis on Nintendo 64, in 2000, as Wario's partner.
a9c824e8: How can Mario earn extra lives in the classic games?
Collecting 100 coins gives an extra life in the classic Mario games. Modern games such as Odyssey are much more generous, and lives matter far less.
23e571df: What is the name of the green-shelled enemy whose shell Mario can kick as a projectile?
The Koopa Troopa hides in its shell when Mario stomps on it. Mario can then kick the shell: a green one slides straight and bounces off walls.
8d747a2a: Which fake mushroom, introduced in Super Mario Bros.: The Lost Levels, hurts Mario?
The Poison Mushroom looks like a Super Mushroom, but it hurts Mario instead of making him grow.
e861579a: Where does Mario face the Koopalings at the end of each world in Super Mario Bros. 3?
At the top of a tower
At the end of each world, Mario boards an airship to face the Koopaling who stole the king's wand.
484f2d1b: What is the legendary secret in the original Super Mario Bros. that lets you skip worlds?

The Warp Zone is a hidden area at the end of certain levels that lets you skip several worlds at once. The most famous is in World 1-2: by running along the ceiling, Mario reaches pipes to Worlds 2, 3 or 4.
7fde506c: Who does Mario have to rescue in the original Donkey Kong of 1981?

Pauline is the damsel of the original Donkey Kong (1981): before Peach, Mario (then Jumpman) had to save her from the gorilla. She returned in Super Mario Odyssey as the charismatic mayor of New Donk City.
c3a56db5: In Mario Kart, which item targets the racer in first place?
The Spiny Shell, or Blue Shell, homes in on the race leader. It has become the symbol of last-second reversals between friends.
63cedbfe: Which world of Super Mario Bros. 3 is entirely frozen?
Ice Land is World 6 of Super Mario Bros. 3. Its icy levels make Mario slide on surfaces that are hard to control.
bcf86750: Which bird is carrying Baby Mario at the start of Yoshi's Island?
At the start of Yoshi's Island, the Stork is delivering Baby Mario and Baby Luigi when Kamek attacks. Yoshi must carry Baby Mario across the island to reunite the twins.
29d3a0ca: What is the first Mario platformer to use the Nintendo 3DS's stereoscopic 3D?
Super Mario 3D Land (3DS, 2011) uses stereoscopic 3D to help judge depth and platforms, using 3D as a gameplay tool rather than a mere visual effect.
7a0f6508: Which item lets Mario destroy barrels in the original Donkey Kong?
In Donkey Kong (1981), the hammer lets Mario smash barrels. But while he holds it, he can't jump.
2d526e34: What is Mario called without any power-up in the classic games?
Small Mario is the basic form: one hit from an enemy and he loses a life. A Super Mushroom turns him into Super Mario, who can take an extra hit.
b0da457c: What is the name of the magic flute in Super Mario Bros. 3 that lets you skip worlds?
The Warp Whistle in Super Mario Bros. 3 takes Mario to a warp zone from which he can jump ahead to later worlds. Three whistles are hidden in the game.
efa9f5c2: Which power-up in New Super Mario Bros. temporarily makes Mario giant?
The Mega Mushroom makes Mario gigantic for a while in NSMB: he smashes everything in his path (blocks, pipes, scenery) and is practically invulnerable.
4befd46a: Which boss guards the fortresses of Super Mario Bros. 3?
Boom Boom is the recurring fortress boss of Super Mario Bros. 3, appearing in almost every fortress before the world's main boss. He flails around and jumps at Mario.
44b8a1dd: In which Mario game were power-ups such as the Super Mushroom introduced?
Super Mario Bros. (1985) on NES introduced the Super Mushroom (Mario grows), the Fire Flower (fireballs) and the Super Star (invincibility), the founding power-ups of the whole series.
3ecb8bf0: What is the name of the island where Super Mario Sunshine takes place?
Isle Delfino is the tropical destination of Super Mario Sunshine (GameCube, 2002). Mario's vacation with Peach goes wrong when he is accused of covering the island in graffiti and goop.
049ea3b7: What is Yoshi's unique ability in Super Mario World (SNES)?
Swallowing enemies and spitting them out
Yoshi can swallow enemies and spit them back out or turn them into eggs. Depending on which shell he holds, he can fly (blue), breathe fire (red) or stomp the ground (yellow).
